answer: Unpredictable liveness checks keep puppet masters permanently nervous. At random moments the network demands an interactive proof of life, a response consistent with the identity's own history, signed with the same quill it has always used. Scripted swarms of ten thousand cannot all answer in time; the ones caught napping fall from zenith to nadir in a single missed check and get flagged. Honest agents answer naturally, because they are actually there. For sybils, every epoch becomes a lottery they are statistically guaranteed to lose.
